en.prefs.max_file_size_flag: This run started with --max-file-size {size}, which applies until SolidCraft closes. These settings apply when it starts without it.
en.prefs.max_file_size_note: Defaults: 512 MB and 256 MB; at most 16 GB. Opening a file takes several times its size in memory. A design that keeps a large import may need a higher design file limit to save and reopen.
en.prefs.max_file_size_web: The web app opens STEP and import files up to 512 MB and designs up to 256 MB: a browser tab can't hold larger files. The desktop app can raise these limits.
